items.title: 32.11 Kimiyai sanatein aur Pakistan ki maeeshat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chemical industries and Pakistan's economy (PDF 241-242).

blocks.text: Kimiyai sanat Pakistan ki maeeshat ke liye intehai ahem hai: yeh Gross Domestic Product (GDP) mein numayan hissa dalti aur rozgar deti hai. Yeh doosre bare shobon jaise zaraat (khaad ke zariye), tameerat (cement ke zariye) aur kapre ki sanat (dyes aur masnoi reshon ke zariye) ko sahara deti hai. Mulk ke apne kache maal, jaise qudrati gas, namak, chuna-pathar aur kacha tel, se kaleedi products banana dar-aamad par inhisar kam karta hai.

Zarai maeeshat hone ke naate Pakistan ki khurak ki hifazat kimiyai sanat par munhasir hai: maqami companies qudrati gas se urea banati hain, jis se qaumi dar-aamad ka bill arbon dollar kam hota hai. Kapre ki sanat Pakistan ki baraamadat (exports) ka 50% se zyada hai, aur yeh sanat cotton ki mercerising ke liye caustic soda, rang aur pukhtagi ke liye masnoi dyes, aur kapre safed karne ke liye hydrogen peroxide bari miqdar mein use karti hai. Tameerati mansoobon aur shehri phailao ki wajah se cement ki sanat hamsaya ilaqon ko bari baraamad karne wali ban gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Maqami qudrati gas se urea banana Pakistan ki maeeshat ki kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh zaraat aur khurak ki hifazat ko sahara deta aur qaumi dar-aamad ka bill arbon dollar kam karta hai.

items: Kimiyai sanat: GDP, rozgar; zaraat, tameerat, kapre ko sahara.
Maqami urea dar-aamad ghatati; kapra (50% se zyada baraamad) caustic soda, dyes, H2O2 use karta; cement baraamad.
